summary: Onconetix filed an 8-K disclosing a $5.0 million grid promissory note with Realbotix, LLC, advancing $2.5 million on September 11, 2026, unsecured, guaranteed by Realbotix Corp., maturing September 11, 2027, interest-free until the Share Exchange Agreement termination (then 12%). The underlying February 11, 2026 share exchange would have Onconetix acquire Realbotix for stock, with a $12.5 million net cash condition and $500,000 closing adjustment. Watch the equity issuance and financing condition risk-arb angle.
